description: ODC (data lot, phase 3): the life cycle of the entity MODEL over an inherited model (job:data-full-model: WfCovOrganization -> WfCovProject -> WfCovTask with FKs, indexes and the static WfCovPriority). Nothing here is CRUD of published records. (1) READ: entity, attributes, the child `WfCovTask Identifier` (IIdentifierType, generated by the platform: it is what the FKs link to, which is why the entity usages under-reports), indexes incl. the AutoIndex of the FKs. (2) CREATE a related entity by spec with FK and a COMPOSITE unique index (WfCovMilestone), and an attribute + a composite index by raw verbs on an inherited entity. (3) EDIT properties of existing attributes (Length, IsMandatory, Description, DefaultValue, DataType of an attribute WITHOUT consumers). (4) REAL CONSUMER: public server action with an aggregate and a filter that cites the attribute. (5) RENAME an entity and attributes with consumers and read what followed (filter, indexes, FK) and what did not follow (index name). (6) MOVE an attribute. (7) INDEX: change Unique, delete without consumers; the composition is changed by deleting and recreating (there is no verb). (8) DELETE an attribute without author consumers (the IRecordAttributeValue is derived). Headless execution is not a database migration: changing type/mandatory/uniqueness on a published database has consequences that this job does not prove.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
